**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The contract's Article 18 already satisfies our preferred insurance position in full:

| Playbook (preferred) | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occ, 2M agg | ✔ Matched exactly |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✔ Matched |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | ✔ Matched |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✔ Matched (plus employer's liability USD 1M, an extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✔ § 18.2 |

Additional protections beyond the playbook ask: coverage extends one year past the term, policies must be from reputable insurers and primary to our insurance where customary, advance notice of cancellation/material reduction, and express confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities.

Note on the planner's flag regarding health-data risk: the cyber limit is at our preferred USD 5M, so no deviation exists under this rule. If Juniper Ridge's PHI volume warrants a higher cyber limit than the standard playbook figure, that would be a business escalation rather than a playbook deviation, and would be better paired with a review of the liability cap.
